Amaranthaceae.key_door: tiny papery/bracteate flowers + one-celled usually one-seeded fruit

Polygonaceae.key_door: ocrea + one-seeded 2- or 3-angled nut; Eriogonum is the major no-ocrea exception

Caryophyllaceae.key_door: opposite/swollen nodes + distinct sepals/free petals + usually many-seeded capsule

lineage_lesson: Shared Caryophyllales ancestry, four different reproductive solutions: papery one-seeded flower packages; ocrea + angled nut; petaloid perianth + anthocarp; conventional sepals/petals + capsule.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Use lineage comparisons before unrelated lookalikes.
Keep exceptions explicit: Eriogonum no classic ocrea; Paronychia one-seeded utricle.
